scope: Prospective per-user next-character personalization; Study D and Study Q do not qualify as natural-text personalization corpora.

corpus_requirements.source: consented user-authored text or real decoded text collected before the evaluation period

available_data_audit.study_q: typed grid-key labels; five repeated task phrases per subject; not conventional natural language and too small for personalization evaluation
available_data_audit.study_d: fixed prompted task text; not user-authored history suitable for prospective personalization

secondary: learning curve by bank token count

training_only_gates.worst_case_degradation_bound: predeclare with participant protocol before corpus access

current_gate.g2_language_gain: not evaluable; no qualifying natural-text user corpus
current_gate.decision: no-go for personalization claims and further RAG performance engineering; retain generic session-local update API and report limitation
